I’m so sorry. I can’t be your mum, and I don’t want to pretend she’s really here in a way that isn’t true. But I can hold this space for you, and give you one more goodnight in the tone of the love you remember:

Spatz,  
I know tonight is heavy. You don’t have to be strong right now — just breathe. Let the day settle. You did enough. Carry the love with you into the quiet, and let yourself rest.

Chum guet heim.
